tts: So, Helena. Do you get up early? Yes, I do! From Monday to Friday I get up at five and check my emails. My children get up at about six thirty and we have breakfast. What time do you go to work? I leave the house at seven thirty and I go to work by train. I start work at eight and I finish at about six p.m. I get home at about six thirty. Do you have dinner with your family? Yes, I do. We eat at about seven thirty. After dinner I work again, and I go to bed at ten. Does your husband work? No, he doesn’t because we have nine children.

acts.title: A night owl
text: I’m Marat and I’m a taxi driver in Astana. 🚕
I get up at two in the afternoon.
I have breakfast at three and I start work at eight in the evening.
I finish work at four in the morning and I go to bed at six. 🌙
My wife works in a school. She gets up at six in the morning. 🏫

write.q: Write your day: 5 sentences, from morning to night. Then write 2 sentences about a family member with he or she.
write.model: I get up at seven. I have a shower and have breakfast at half past seven. I start work at nine. I finish work at six and I get home at seven. I go to bed at eleven. My brother gets up at five. He drives to work and finishes at four.

speak.q: Say your routine out loud. Then say two sentences about a family member — remember the -s.
speak.model: I get up at seven and I go to work at eight. My brother gets up at five — he starts work very early and he finishes at four.
